nodes.title: Set-up and sign-in wear Volt night through K's own scope: StepFrame's root is .kx + data-klook=volt + data-ktheme=night, and src/onboarding/volt.css re-points the v2 tokens the shared components read at K's --k-* tokens (as childshell.css does), with no colour literal. The child's moments (her voice previews, her name) sit in a nested .kx panel in her family look (classes 1-4 Volt day). Lime only on the step's primary action. Reversal: K ships a set-up component set of its own, or the owner wants the grown-up surface calmer than night.

Set-up and sign-in before/after, a production build against the stream's Neon TEST branch, headless Chromium, a fresh account per viewport (n=1 per viewport per side, 12 surfaces each): 0 page errors and 0 horizontal overflow before and after at 360x800, 412x915 and 1366x768. The promises hold gate top/bottom after: 653/713 at 360x800 (was 708/756), 633/693 at 412x915, 689/749 at 1366x768: above the fold everywhere.
A drop-shadow glow on the chamfered CTA: clip-path clips the filter, so the glow never shows. The one move breathes with an inner light sweep instead.
